title.zh: 周长 vs 面积 · 一根绳子两种账
title.en: Perimeter vs Area · One Rope, Two Ledgers

desc.zh: 一根 24 米的绳子围地：绳子账（周长）怎么围都不变，地砖账（面积）却从 11 一路变到 36——越接近正方形越大；再反过来，面积固定时细长形状最费绳子。两个最容易混的量，这次分得清清楚楚。
desc.en: Fence a plot with one 24-metre rope: the rope ledger (perimeter) never changes, but the tile ledger (area) runs from 11 all the way to 36 — the closer to a square, the bigger; then in reverse, fixed area costs the most rope when long and thin. Two quantities everyone mixes up, finally kept apart.
